description: Return the completed image as an MCP image content block. Requires the same token/identity that submitted the job. Images expire after 24 hours from submission; download before expiry.

access_token.description: Account API credential from My account; omit when Bearer authorization is configured. Never include it in prompts.

job_id.description: Exact owned job identifier returned by submission; preserve it for polling and retrieval.
